title: Wombats Poop Cubes, and Science Knows Why

beats.say: Wombats poop cubes. Not round pellets, real little cubes.
So how does an animal make square poop?
A 2018 study found the answer is inside their gut.
Their intestines stretch unevenly, and that shapes the droppings into cubes.
Wombats stack them on rocks and logs to mark their territory.
And here's the smart part: cubes don't roll away.
Did you know wombats could do this?
